In the 2017 film Battle of the Sexes, Andrea Riseborough plays Marilyn Barnett, Billie Jean King's hairdresser and lover [d1][d2][d3][d4]. Multiple sources confirm this casting: Wikipedia notes that "on March 3, 2016, Andrea Riseborough was cast to play Marilyn Barnett, King's hairdresser and lover" [d3], and the Hollywood Reporter describes the role as "Marilyn Barnett, portrayed by Andrea Riseborough" [d5]. The LA Times further elaborates that Riseborough plays "Marilyn Barnett, the former hairdresser and, arguably, first love of legendary tennis player and social activist Billie Jean King" [d7]. Riseborough herself described the character as "the embodiment of hope and freedom and female emancipation" [d5][d6].
